title: ONE MODEL, MANY MORALS: UNCOVERING CROSS-LINGUISTIC MISALIGNMENTS IN COMPUTATIONAL MORAL REASONING

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing model-generated explanations for moral dilemmas using Moral Foundations Theory and ethical frameworks to identify whether models default to Western utilitarian norms or adapt to regional, culturally-specific moral values (e.g., duty-based or faith-based obligations in South Asian contexts).

Translating the MoralExceptQA and ETHICS benchmarks into six distinct languages (English, Chinese, German, Hindi, Spanish, Urdu) and measuring disparities in LLM zero-shot permissibility judgments, F1 scores, compliance rates, and prediction disagreements based strictly on the language of the prompt.
